stem:
This excerpt is from a letter written by a Founding Father.

Our liberty depends on the freedom of the press, and that cannot be limited without being lost.

—Thomas Jefferson, Letter to James Currie, January 28, 1786

Why did Jefferson believe this freedom was significant?

options.label: A
options.text: To prevent political parties from sharing information about opponents

options.label: B
options.text: To allow governmental review of information prior to publication

options.label: C
options.text: To allow different points of view to be shared with the public

options.label: D
options.text: To prevent criticism of elected officials who pass laws

visual_elements: Boxed excerpt of Thomas Jefferson's letter: 'Our liberty depends on the freedom of the press, and that cannot be limited without being lost.'
